EmailTemplate.name: Virtual Campus Tour
EmailTemplate.subject: Explore ASU’s campuses with an online tour
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in Arizona State University. ASU is unique because we are one university in many places. We have four distinct locations in the Phoenix metropolitan area offering undergraduate programs. Freshmen are expected to live on the campus of their major, but students have access to courses, activities and opportunities at all of our locations. A free intercampus shuttle helps students get between locations.
ASU's online tours introduce you to the beauty and identity of each campus.
Downtown Phoenix campus at http://www.asu.edu/tour/downtown/ Polytechnic campus at http://www.asu.edu/tour/polytechnic/ Tempe campus at http://www.asu.edu/tour/tempe/ West campus at http://www.asu.edu/tour/west/
See what your future could look like at ASU by visiting http://asu.edu/myfuture/study.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me.
Sincerely,
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
